title: tephrosia filifolia
intro: Tephrosia filifolia, commonly known as the "Wild Bean", is a plant species belonging to the Fabaceae family. This plant is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to treat various diseases such as fever, rheumatism, and skin conditions. The therapeutic actions of Tephrosia filifolia include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which contribute to its medicinal value. The bioactive constituents of the plant include flavonoids, glycosides, and alkaloids, which are responsible for its therapeutic effects.
